acceptance: Sign-in, sign-out and challenge evidence is accepted only from a bridge-vouched paired runtime session with fresh, ordered, non-replayed messages bound to application, origin, principal and epoch; anything unprovable mints nothing.

positive.fixture: evidence from a bridge-vouched session mints, renews, pauses and resumes; a restarted runtime continues the grant under a new epoch

negative.fixture: sixteen forged or stale variants mint nothing; replay, out-of-order and older-epoch messages change nothing; no bridge or no application proof means no grant

security_and_source_permissions: A page script or unpaired local caller cannot produce evidence; VSF never answers a challenge.
performance_memory_storage: Ordering state is pruned after two freshness windows; at most 8192 marks.
known_limitations: Needs the transport to set Evidence.Client from the authenticated pairing; the extension path to Evidence is not part of B14
